_comment: Curated law-peep slug → Wikidata QID map (#518). Only acts with a matching et/en Wikipedia sitelink are included. Eesti Vabariigi põhiseadus is required. Karistusseadustik and Võlaõigusseadus have etwiki pages whose title is the act name. Tsiviilseadustiku üldosa seadus and Perekonnaseadus have no et/en Wikipedia article (pages missing), so they are omitted rather than guessed. Issue #518 listed Q211204 for the Constitution; that item is Carlos Sainz and is not used.
